'''Miles Smith Balanced Smiley Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Miles Smith]]
* '''Published:''' March 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Hoth]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)|Hoth-D-hothdefensiveperimeter.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Balanced Smiley Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PHoth Balanced Smiley Deck Smith DS 1997.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

This deck is really balanced and can control both space and ground. The space weapons are there so you can stop Attack Runs and get rid of passenger- filled Corellian Corvettes. I can beat everyone at my school with this deck, even players who have most of the main characters.

== Strategy ==

As I said above he space weapons are there so you can stop Attack Runs and get rid of passenger- filled Corellian Corvettes.

Most of the interrupts are used so you can keep using their high destiny.

The key to this deck is to Force drain for at least two. The exception to this is Kessel, which lets you deploy -1 and annoys your rebel 'friend' so much when you replace his.

Save the Mosep until you have a secure site, preferably with Djas Puhr and a lightsaber so that the Force drain is +1 and from the reserve pile.
